article.hook: Someone just rewired their argument mid-sentence - and you noticed. Mercury in Aquarius sharpens the mind to spot patterns nobody else sees and toss out the expected script.
article.lived: For the next few weeks, your thoughts pivot to connections beneath the surface. Conversations crack open with unexpected links and questions that challenge how the pieces fit. You might find yourself sketching a new framework on the back of a napkin or rearranging priorities based on fresh data. This isn’t slow reflection; it’s a quick jump to what’s next, what’s unseen, what rewrites the rules.
article.turn: That same quicksilver logic can turn cold and dismissive fast. When ideas outrun empathy, you risk sounding like you’re debating a theory instead of talking to a person. The sharper the insight, the easier it becomes to forget who’s listening. Don’t trade connection for cleverness - an idea without an ear is just noise.
